analysis.purpose: Test helper (a closure nested inside runWs) that strips Node's ExperimentalWarning/trace-warnings noise lines from captured subprocess output, so log noise doesn't leak into stdout/stderr assertions.
responsibilities: Rejoin the remaining lines and trim the result
invariants: Output never contains a line matching /ExperimentalWarning|trace-warnings/
preconditions: Called with the raw stdout or stderr string captured from a spawned CLI process
outputs: string — output with noise lines removed and trimmed
errorBehavior: No error handling; a non-string input would throw at .split, but callers always pass strings
risks: A future Node warning with different wording (not matching ExperimentalWarning|trace-warnings) would leak through unfiltered
